name: Old Bridge, Makurdi
facts: The Old Bridge, Makurdi, opened on 24 May 1932 by Donald Cemeron, aligning its inauguration with Empire Day celebrations.
Spanning roughly half a mile, the bridge’s 2,584‑foot length made it Africa’s longest bridge at the time, a monumental £1,000,000 project by Sir William Arrol & Co.
Designed to replace a ferry service, the 3 ft 6 in gauge rail and road bridge crossed the Benue River at a narrow, 200‑foot high point chosen for its strategic elevation.
